plan.notes: Source: official TJC 2025-2026 Catalog with Addendum (catoid=15), Program: Game and Simulation Development, AAS (poid=2811). Major Courses: 45 credits; General Education Requirements: 15 credits (marked *); Total Semester Hours: 60. 'Select one course from the following' and 'OR' options modeled per course choice_note (first-listed option used). COSC 1436 (4 cr) and COSC 2436 (4 cr) appear as alternates to 3-cr courses; choosing them raises the total above 60. '#' = course only taught in the fall semester; '+' = only taught in the spring semester; some courses are offered fall-only or spring-only, so plan accordingly. Prerequisites are not listed on the program page; see the catalog course descriptions. TCCNS codes included for Texas transfer reference.
